name: network_environment
summary: Network environment scheduled probe — always-on stage that reports the local network shape.

layers.fixHint: Define `pub const <PROBE>_PROBE_ID: &str = "<wire id>";` in the probe module and implement the Probe trait.

Add a ProbeDescriptor row to PROBE_DESCRIPTORS — id, family, scheduled_probe_type, runner, path_requirement, label. The `every_descriptor_id_is_non_empty_and_unique` and `every_scheduled_inventory_row_has_one_descriptor` tests pin this table.
Mirror the descriptor row in SCHEDULED_PROBE_INVENTORY with ProbeTraitBacking::Backed(<PROBE>_PROBE_ID) — descriptor and inventory must agree on probe_type and runner.
Add a row to PROBE_STAGE_REGISTRATIONS in the monitor-engine registry binding probe_type and probe_id to a runner factory and a stage id.

checklist: Define `pub const <PROBE>_PROBE_ID: &str = "…";` in the new probe module under ripdpi-diagnostics-probes/src/.
Implement the `Probe` trait for the probe (id, family, run).
Add a `ProbeDescriptor` row to `PROBE_DESCRIPTORS` in `probe_descriptor.rs` and to `SCHEDULED_PROBE_INVENTORY` in `scheduled_inventory.rs` (matching probe_type + runner).
Add a `ProbeStageRegistration` row in `ripdpi-monitor-engine/src/engine/runners/registry.rs` binding the runner factory.
Existing tests: probe_descriptor.rs tests (`every_descriptor_id_is_non_empty_and_unique`, `every_scheduled_inventory_row_has_one_descriptor`), monitor-engine `registry.rs` tests.
